not_findings_confirmed_fixed_this_round: RECHECK-02 (major, ADV-L05-04) -- the plan-overlap advisory's concurrency window -- FIXED, independently re-verified: p929.concurrent-creation cell passes (2 pooled connections observed via pg_locks waiting on the client advisory rung 203005004); the three plan-creating doors (create_accounting_plan, revise_accounting_plan, _accrual_plan_core) all carry `perform pg_advisory_xact_lock(203005004, hashtext(...))` placed after op-receipt reservation and before any accounting_plans row lock, confirmed by direct grep of the migration file at lines 440, 536, 683.

RECHECK-03 (major, L05-SPEC-09/ADV-L05-03) -- the sibling advisory's self-exclusion hid total overlap -- FIXED, independently re-verified: p929.identical-basis cell passes; clara._plan_overlap_warning now takes a third argument p_self_plan uuid and excludes by `p.id is distinct from p_self_plan` (confirmed by direct grep of the migration and by querying pg_proc for the live function signature, which returns exactly `p_client uuid, p_basis jsonb, p_self_plan uuid`); the old two-argument overload is confirmed dropped (exactly one overload exists in the live catalog).

The deadlock-safety argument for the new client rung on the three plan-creating doors holds on independent re-derivation: the live catalog census of bodies containing both `pg_advisory_xact_lock(203005004` and `accounting_plans` in prosrc returns exactly 3 rows (create_accounting_plan, revise_accounting_plan, _accrual_plan_core) rather than the fix-2 report's literal '0 rows', but this is fully reconciled by the migration header's own qualifier that its 51-body census was taken BEFORE the rung was added to these same three bodies (51 pre-existing + 3 newly added by this migration = 54, which matches the current live count exactly); within those three the rung is taken strictly before any accounting_plans row lock, so no new cross-body deadlock pair is created. Not a finding.
